key: "Beryl Water Grid"
en: "Beryl Water Grid"
ja: 「ベリル水路網」

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: \PN used the Beryl Grid Key.
en: \PN used the Beryl Grid Key.
ja: \PNはベリルはいでんもうのカギを使った。

key: TITANIA: All right, what the hell is your problem?
en: TITANIA: All right, what the hell is your problem?
ja: ティタニア: いい加減にして、一体何が目的なの?

key: TAKA: Problem?
en: TAKA: Problem?
ja: タカ: 目的?

key: Obviously, I'm just following orders and trying to slow you down.
en: Obviously, I'm just following orders and trying to slow you down.
ja: 見ての通り、命令に従ってあんたたちの足止めをしてるだけだよ。

key: TITANIA: Bullshit.
en: TITANIA: Bullshit.
ja: ティタニア: たわごと言わないで。

key: You're not even trying to hide it anymore.
en: You're not even trying to hide it anymore.
ja: もう隠そうともしてないじゃない。

key: We wouldn't have been able to pass through a single room you changed the water level in, UNLESS you had done that.
en: We wouldn't have been able to pass through a single room you changed the water level in, UNLESS you had done that.
ja: あんたが水位をいじった部屋、あれをしてなかったら、あたしたち一つも通り抜けられなかったはずよ。

key: TAKA: Whaaaat, really?
en: TAKA: Whaaaat, really?
ja: タカ: えぇー、本当に?

key: Oh, goodness.
en: Oh, goodness.
ja: おっと、参ったな。

key: It seems I made a mistake...
en: It seems I made a mistake...
ja: どうやらミスしちゃったみたいだ……

key: TITANIA: You can drop the act.
en: TITANIA: You can drop the act.
ja: ティタニア: その芝居はもうやめて。

key: I don't know what the hell kind of passive-aggressive game you're trying to play, but I'm tired of it.
en: I don't know what the hell kind of passive-aggressive game you're trying to play, but I'm tired of it.
ja: あんたが何のつもりでそんな回りくどい真似をしてるのか知らないけど、もううんざりなの。

key: Are you on Team Meteor's side, or not?
en: Are you on Team Meteor's side, or not?
ja: あんた、チームメテオの側にいるの、いないの?

key: TAKA: Obviously I am, but...
en: TAKA: Obviously I am, but...
ja: タカ: そりゃもちろんいるけど……

key: Look, it's not that simple.
en: Look, it's not that simple.
ja: ねえ、そんな単純な話じゃないんだよ。

key: TITANIA: It's that simple if you let it be.
en: TITANIA: It's that simple if you let it be.
ja: ティタニア: あんた次第で単純にできるでしょ。

key: TAKA: Ugh...
en: TAKA: Ugh...
ja: タカ: うう……

key: To be honest, I don't really agree with much of what Team Meteor does.
en: To be honest, I don't really agree with much of what Team Meteor does.
ja: 正直に言うと、チームメテオのやってることの多くには、僕も賛成できてないんだ。

key: But I'm in here for life, so I've gotta at least pretend to follow suit, you know?
en: But I'm in here for life, so I've gotta at least pretend to follow suit, you know?
ja: でもここに骨をうずめる覚悟でいるから、少なくとも従ってるふりくらいはしないといけないんだよ、分かるだろ?

key: TITANIA: No, I don't know.
en: TITANIA: No, I don't know.
ja: ティタニア: いいえ、分からないわ。

key: If you don't agree with them, don't serve them.
en: If you don't agree with them, don't serve them.
ja: 賛成できないなら、仕えなければいいでしょ。

key: Done and done.
en: Done and done.
ja: それで終わりの話よ。

key: TAKA: I really don't have a choice about that...
en: TAKA: I really don't have a choice about that...
ja: タカ: 本当に、それを選ぶ余地なんてないんだ……

key: TITANIA: Just because you cover your eyes and pretend not to see it doesn't mean it goes away.
en: TITANIA: Just because you cover your eyes and pretend not to see it doesn't mean it goes away.
ja: ティタニア: 目をふさいで見ないふりをしたって、それが消えてなくなるわけじゃないのよ。

key: You always have a choice.
en: You always have a choice.
ja: あんたにはいつだって選択肢があるの。

key: You're just afraid to make it.
en: You're just afraid to make it.
ja: ただ、それを選ぶのが怖いだけ。

key: TAKA: It's-- not like that...
en: TAKA: It's-- not like that...
ja: タカ: それは――そういうことじゃないんだ……

key: Look, my father is the leader of Team Meteor.
en: Look, my father is the leader of Team Meteor.
ja: ねえ、僕の父さんはチームメテオのリーダーなんだ。

key: TITANIA: So?
en: TITANIA: So?
ja: ティタニア: それで?

key: TAKA: My family... It's--
en: TAKA: My family... It's--
ja: タカ: 僕の一族は……その――

key: We're the last direct descendants of the culture that enshrined Arceus' meteor in Reborn so many centuries ago.
en: We're the last direct descendants of the culture that enshrined Arceus' meteor in Reborn so many centuries ago.
ja: 何世紀も前、リボーンにアルセウスのいん石をまつった文化の、最後の直系の子孫なんだ。

key: It's our duty to protect it.
en: It's our duty to protect it.
ja: それを守るのが、僕たちの務めなんだよ。

key: It's my birthright...
en: It's my birthright...
ja: 僕の生まれ持った権利……

key: Or more like my curse.
en: Or more like my curse.
ja: というか、呪いに近いかな。

key: I can't change that.
en: I can't change that.
ja: それは変えられないんだ。

key: TITANIA: Not if you keep acting like a coward.
en: TITANIA: Not if you keep acting like a coward.
ja: ティタニア: そうやって臆病者みたいに振る舞い続けるならね。

key: TAKA: Running from my fate would be cowardice.
en: TAKA: Running from my fate would be cowardice.
ja: タカ: 自分の運命から逃げるなんて、それこそ臆病だよ。

key: TITANIA: Is that what your father told you?
en: TITANIA: Is that what your father told you?
ja: ティタニア: それ、あんたの父親に言われたの?

key: You said yourself you don't agree with Team Meteor's actions, but YOU are allowing this to happen.
en: You said yourself you don't agree with Team Meteor's actions, but YOU are allowing this to happen.
ja: あんた自身、チームメテオのやり方には賛成できないって言ったじゃない。なのに、あんたがそれを許してるのよ。

key: They're YOUR actions too.
en: They're YOUR actions too.
ja: それはあんたの行動でもあるの。

key: If you don't like it, change it.
en: If you don't like it, change it.
ja: 気に入らないなら、変えなさい。

key: If you can't change it, leave it.
en: If you can't change it, leave it.
ja: 変えられないなら、そこを離れなさい。

key: TAKA: You wouldn't understand...
en: TAKA: You wouldn't understand...
ja: タカ: 君には分からないよ……

key: ...But that's okay.
en: ...But that's okay.
ja: ……でも、それでいいんだ。

key: I'm going on ahead, so if you want your friend back, you should follow.
en: I'm going on ahead, so if you want your friend back, you should follow.
ja: 僕は先に行くよ。だから友達を取り戻したいなら、ついてきてよ。

key: TAKA: Oh, and, the key to the door here is in the Lapis Water Grid Room--
en: TAKA: Oh, and, the key to the door here is in the Lapis Water Grid Room--
ja: タカ: あ、それと、ここのドアの鍵はラピス水路網の部屋にあるよ――

key: Have you already been there?
en: Have you already been there?
ja: もうそこには行った?

key: I'm sure Team Meteor would hate it if you happened to clear all the rooms...
en: I'm sure Team Meteor would hate it if you happened to clear all the rooms...
ja: チームメテオとしては、あんたに全部の部屋をクリアされるのは嫌だろうな……

key: So make sure you do that.
en: So make sure you do that.
ja: だから、ちゃんとやっておいたほうがいいよ。

key: TITANIA: Hah... If only he were standing there.
en: TITANIA: Hah... If only he were standing there.
ja: ティタニア: はっ……あいつがここにいてくれたらよかったのに。

key: I'm so SICK of living a lie.
en: I'm so SICK of living a lie.
ja: うそをついて生きるのに、もううんざりなの。

key: Hah, I should thank you for resolving this stupid situation, \PN.
en: Hah, I should thank you for resolving this stupid situation, \PN.
ja: はっ、こんなバカげた状況を解決してくれたこと、あんたに感謝すべきなのよね、\PN。

key: Aside from the part where Amy jumped off a waterfall.
en: Aside from the part where Amy jumped off a waterfall.
ja: エイミーが滝から飛び降りた件は別にして。

key: No thanks for that.
en: No thanks for that.
ja: あれに関しては礼なんて言わないから。

key: But I'm so tired of this.
en: But I'm so tired of this.
ja: でも、もうこんなの本当に疲れた。

key: I can't STAND seeing somebody else act so--
en: I can't STAND seeing somebody else act so--
ja: 誰かがそんなふうに振る舞ってるのを見てると――

key: TITANIA: Forget it.
en: TITANIA: Forget it.
ja: ティタニア: もういいわ。

key: I'm just tired.
en: I'm just tired.
ja: ただ疲れてるだけ。

key: TITANIA: ...I'll be fine. Go ahead, I'm right behind you.
en: TITANIA: ...I'll be fine. Go ahead, I'm right behind you.
ja: ティタニア: ……大丈夫。先に行って、すぐ後ろにいるから。

key: TITANIA: I think-- I need a moment.
en: TITANIA: I think-- I need a moment.
ja: ティタニア: ちょっと――ちょっと休ませて。

key: Unlike the commander, our faith will not be shaken.
en: Unlike the commander, our faith will not be shaken.
ja: 司令官と違い、我らの信仰は揺るがない。

key: Therefore, allow us to demonstrate the strength of our resolve.
en: Therefore, allow us to demonstrate the strength of our resolve.
ja: だからこそ、我らの覚悟の強さを示させてもらおう。

key: TITANIA: And allow ME to demonstrate how pitiful your resolve is.
en: TITANIA: And allow ME to demonstrate how pitiful your resolve is.
ja: ティタニア: だったら、あたしがあんたたちのしょぼい覚悟がどれだけ情けないか、見せつけてあげる。

key: Enough!
en: Enough!
ja: イコラス: もうたくさんだ!

key: We are servants of the world; please do not contest us!
en: We are servants of the world; please do not contest us!
ja: ライラ: 私たちは世界に仕える者。どうか邪魔をしないでください!

key: TITANIA: Stand aside.
en: TITANIA: Stand aside.
ja: ティタニア: どきなさい。

key: TITANIA: It would be so easy for me to end you right now.
en: TITANIA: It would be so easy for me to end you right now.
ja: ティタニア: あんたたちを終わらせるくらい、あたしには簡単なことよ。

key: TITANIA: Understand?
en: TITANIA: Understand?
ja: ティタニア: 分かった?

key: So here's what's going to happen.
en: So here's what's going to happen.
ja: これから、こうするから。

key: I'm going to kill you.
en: I'm going to kill you.
ja: あんたを殺す。

key: TITANIA: There. The person you were, is now dead.
en: TITANIA: There. The person you were, is now dead.
ja: ティタニア: これで。かつてのあんたはもう死んだの。

key: And you're both going to go somewhere far, far away, forget all of this ever happened, and truly start living for yourselves.
en: And you're both going to go somewhere far, far away, forget all of this ever happened, and truly start living for yourselves.
ja: そして二人とも、どこか遠くへ行って、こんなことは全部忘れて、本当に自分のために生き始めなさい。

key: Am I clear?
en: Am I clear?
ja: 分かった?

key: Then go.
en: Then go.
ja: じゃあ、行きなさい。

key: TITANIA: That's really not nearly as satisfying as just killing them outright.
en: TITANIA: That's really not nearly as satisfying as just killing them outright.
ja: ティタニア: あっさり殺しちゃうより、全然満足できないわね。

key: TITANIA: I'll leave the door to you.
en: TITANIA: I'll leave the door to you.
ja: ティタニア: あとのドアはあんたに任せるわ。

key: TITANIA: Oh, you're done already.
en: TITANIA: Oh, you're done already.
ja: ティタニア: あら、もう終わったの。

key: You'll have to excuse me if I'm a little reckless with what little energy I have.
en: You'll have to excuse me if I'm a little reckless with what little energy I have.
ja: 残り少ないエネルギーで無茶するけど、大目に見てね。

key: TITANIA: Anyway, I'll leave the door to you.
en: TITANIA: Anyway, I'll leave the door to you.
ja: ティタニア: とにかく、あとのドアはあんたに任せるわ。
